item.miragemask.mirage_mask.desc1: Hold right-click to put the mask on for 60 seconds
item.miragemask.mirage_mask.desc2: Everyone sees you as a mob, a villager or a copy of another player - the look adapts to your surroundings
item.miragemask.mirage_mask.desc3: Attacking or shooting breaks the mask. Recharges for 2 minutes after it fades
message.miragemask.on: Mask on: you are a mirage
message.miragemask.already: The mask is already on your face
